messages:
metrics-bot: ALERT: per-model throughput panels (per_model_qps) dropped to 0 for ~120 models in prod-us-west-2 at 11:02 UTC
devon: Seeing customer ticket spike, +5 CS pings. Is this a grafana query fallout or real QPS drop?
maria: Checking ingest and exporter logs now. No change in request counts at the LB layer.
ajay: API logs show normal traffic. Likely a metrics rename or label migration.
sasha: Which dashboards? per-model charts under /dashboards/model-telemetry and per-route rollups.
maria: quick prometheus query: `sum by (model_id) (rate(redwood_model_qps_total[5m]))` returns zeros. But `sum(rate(rw_model_qps_total[5m]))` returns expected numbers (no labels).
devon: So exporter renamed metric from redwood_model_qps_total -> rw_model_qps_total and dropped model_id label?
ajay: Checking recent deploys: metrics-agent v2.4.0 pushed 10:40 UTC with a codepath that uses model_tag instead of model_id for performance reasons.
maria: Log snippet from metrics-agent: `INFO emitted metric rw_model_qps_total{model_tag="gpt-3.5-redwood"} 42`
sasha: Dashboards are still querying by `model_id`. That explains 0s.
devon: Can we hotfix dashboards to accept both labels? Might be heavy. Alternative: add relabel/copy in Prometheus scrape or exporter to reintroduce model_id label.
ajay: Quick plan: add a temporary recording rule to map rw_model_qps_total -> redwood_model_qps_total with model_id label set from model_tag, plus a relabel in metrics-agent to emit model_id. Which is faster?
maria: Recording rule is fastest, but we need model_id values. model_tag == model_id for 98% of models, but a few internal aliases differ. We should preserve existing model_id where available.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline for metrics-agent -> build passed for v2.4.1
devon: Maria, can you craft a relabel config to copy model_tag -> model_id when model_id missing?
maria: Example relabel we can add to prometheus scrape_config for metrics-agent targets:
```
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_model_tag]
    target_label: model_id
    action: replace
```
ajay: I'll also add a Grafana fallback in a couple of panels: `label_replace(sum by (model_id) (rate(redwood_model_qps_total[5m])), "model_id", "$1", "model_id", "(.*)") or label_replace(sum by (model_tag) (rate(rw_model_qps_total[5m])), "model_id", "$1", "model_tag", "(.*)")` will prefer model_id but fall back to model_tag.
sasha: Who's applying the prometheus relabel? Needs infra approval.
devon: I can approve for emergency change. Ajay, patch prometheus scrape for metrics-agent and reload.
ajay: Patching now in infra/pr-678. Will reload Prometheus via prometheus-operator rollout.
triage-bot: Incident severity: P2 (customer-facing visualization outage).
metrics-bot: Prometheus reload triggered by ajay at 11:30 UTC
maria: After reload, `sum by (model_id) (rate(redwood_model_qps_total[5m]))` returns numbers again for most models. A few still missing where tag != id.
devon: Good. CS: send update to customers: graphs should repopulate, some models may still show gaps for aliases.
ajay: I'll follow up with exporter team to emit both labels in next minor release (metrics-agent v2.5.0) and add a unit test to prevent label-only renames.
sasha: Added Grafana fallback to 3 panels as stopgap.
devon: Postmortem action items?
maria: 1) Add automated smoke for per-model dashboards that alerts if >30% panels zero for 5m. 2) Exporter should never drop model_id without dual-labeling and opt-in. 3) Release notes/process change for metrics schema changes.
ajay: Created ticket INFRA-1324 for recorder rule + exporter patch.
oncall-bot: Incident acknowledged and set to resolved in pagerduty after mitigation at 11:47 UTC :white_check_mark:
devon: Closing thread once CS confirms reduced noise. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
